versions.changelog:
- Initial release of nonsense-literature-crafter skill.
- Generates “废话文学” (nonsense literature) from user input using techniques like repetition, circular reasoning, and vague modifiers.
- Triggered by any user sentence or explicit instructions to “废话” a text.
- Preserves the topic and feeling of the original input without adding new information.
- Outputs concise, philosophical-sounding nonsense spanning 2-5 sentences.
